about_the_game:
Beasts & Rogues is a roguelike deckbuilder where you tame mythical beasts, fuse them with legendary rogues, and create unstoppable strategies. Capture mythical creatures, evolve them into even greater forms, and merge them with your heroes to unlock powerful synergies. Every run is different. Build your deck, master unique abilities, and survive an ever-changing dark fantasy world!

  • Tame & Evolve: Capture mythical beasts from ancient legends and evolve them into powerful forms.

  • Fusion System: Merge beasts with rogues for incredible transformations that change your deck, abilities, and playstyle.

  • Deckbuilding Depth: Create powerful synergies with unique cards, hero skills, and fusion upgrades.

  • Synergy System: Unlock powerful buffs by assembling teams of beasts and rogues with complementary traits and abilities.

  • Strategic Combat – Every battle is a puzzle—use terrain, status effects, and fusion forms to your advantage.

  • Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated encounters, unlockable characters, and hidden
